info.title: ChuChariot knowledge API
info.description: Implemented Neo4j-backed API. Server configuration controls publication mode. Additional inspector, resource and history endpoints are documented by the live OpenAPI document.

post.description: 再次检查权限、当前修订及校验结果，提交事实、派生边和审计为同一事务。审核身份来自凭据，不接受客户端冒填。

OperatorBearer.description: 操作员凭据只在获准实施后配置；本草案不包含任何实际凭据

LegacyDataset.description: 完整v0.4导出形态，嵌套记录仍须通过现有validation.py及所选本体；不是任意对象入库许可。

Operation.description: Create/update complete active records; review uses server identity. Delete archives the record, restore uses its archived content. Referenced deletions must be explicitly resolved in the same change set.

NotFound.description: 记录不存在或对该调用者不可见

Conflict.description: 基线修订过期、同键不同内容或状态冲突

Unavailable.description: 数据库或内部鉴权配置尚未就绪
